description_en: Triggers elastic scaling based on a specified adjustment rule
description_zh: 基于指定调整规则触发弹性扩缩容
kebab_example: aliyun ess scale-with-adjustment --scaling-group-id asg-j6c1o397427hyjdc0000 --adjustment-type QuantityChangeInCapacity --adjustment-value 100 --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ScaleWithAdjustment

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The adjustment method of the scaling activity. Valid values:

QuantityChangeInCapacity: adds or removes a specified number of ECS instances.
PercentChangeInCapacity: adds or removes a specified percentage of ECS instances.
TotalCapacity: adjusts the number of ECS instances in the current scaling group to a specified value
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩活动调整方式，取值范围：

QuantityChangeInCapacity：增加或减少指定数量的ECS实例。
PercentChangeInCapacity：增加或减少指定比例的ECS实例。
TotalCapacity：将当前伸缩组的ECS实例数量调整到指定数量
parameters.name: adjustment_type

parameters.help_en:
The adjustment value of the scaling activity. The number of ECS instances adjusted in a single scaling activity cannot exceed 1000. Otherwise, the adjustment fails. Valid values for different adjustment methods:
QuantityChangeInCapacity: -1000 to 1000.
PercentChangeInCapacity: -100 to 10000.
TotalCapacity: 0 to 2000
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩活动调整值。任何情况下，单次调整的ECS实例台数都不能超过1000，否则会导致调整失败。不同调整方式对应的取值范围：
QuantityChangeInCapacity：-1000~1000。
PercentChangeInCapacity：-100~10000。
TotalCapacity：0~2000
parameters.name: adjustment_value

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of instances to adjust in a scaling activity. This parameter takes effect only when `AdjustmentType` is set to `PercentChangeInCapacity`
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩活动最小调整实例数，仅当`AdjustmentType`为`PercentChangeInCapacity`时生效
parameters.name: min_adjustment_magnitude

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent repeated submissions. The value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length and cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求之间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to synchronously execute the scaling activity. This parameter is valid only for scaling groups that have the expected number of instances configured. Valid values:

true: synchronous execution. The scaling rule directly triggers the scaling activity of the scaling group.
false: asynchronous execution. When the expected number of instances in the scaling group is modified, the scaling activity is not immediately triggered. The system waits until it detects a difference between the expected number of instances and the current number of instances in the scaling group, and then triggers the scaling activity.

For more information about the expected number of instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/146231.html.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩活动同步执行开关，仅对具有期望实例数配置项的伸缩组有效。取值范围：

true：同步流程，即执行伸缩规则时会直接触发伸缩组的扩缩容活动。
false：异步流程，即修改伸缩组内的期望实例数时，不会立刻触发伸缩组的实际扩缩容活动，需等待期望实例数变化后，系统自动检测期望实例数与伸缩组内当前实例数不一致，才会触发扩缩容活动。

关于期望实例数的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/146231.html。

默认值：false
parameters.name: sync_activity

fields.help_en: The arguments for the container startup commands. A maximum of 10 arguments are supported
fields.help_zh: 容器启动命令对应的参数。最多10个
fields.name: arg

fields.help_en: The container startup commands. A maximum of 20 commands are supported. Each command can contain up to 256 characters
fields.help_zh: 容器启动命令。最多20个。每个命令最多包含256个字符
fields.name: command

fields.help_en: The number of vCPUs of the container. Unit: cores
fields.name: cpu

fields.help_en: The name of the environment variable. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. The name must match the format `[0-9a-zA-Z]` and can contain underscores (_). It cannot start with a digit
fields.help_zh: 环境变量名。长度为1~128个字符。格式要求：`[0-9a-zA-Z]`，以及下划线（_），不能以数字开头
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the environment variable. The value can be 0 to 256 characters in length
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The list of environment variable information
fields.name: environment_var

fields.help_en: The memory size of the container. Unit: GiB
fields.name: memory

fields.help_en: The container name. If you want to override container parameters, you must specify the container name. The container parameters can be overridden only when the container name matches the container name in the scaling configuration
fields.help_zh: 容器名称。当需要覆写容器参数时，必须指定容器名称，容器名称与伸缩配置中的容器名称相匹配时，方可覆写容器参数
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The override parameters for the container list
fields.name: container_override

fields.help_en: The number of vCPUs at the instance level. Unit: cores
fields.name: cpu

fields.help_en: The memory size at the instance level. Unit: GiB
fields.help_zh: 实例级别内存大小。单位：GiB
fields.name: memory

parameters.help_en: The override parameters for scale-out in ECI-type scaling groups
parameters.help_zh: ECI类型的伸缩组扩容指定覆写参数
parameters.name: overrides

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to disable all lifecycle hook features for the scaling activity. Valid values:

true: disabled.
false: not disabled
fields.help_zh:
伸缩活动是否禁用所有生命周期挂钩功能。取值范围：

true：禁用。
false：不禁用
fields.name: disable_lifecycle_hook

fields.help_en: The list of lifecycle hook IDs to be disabled for the scaling activity
fields.help_zh: 伸缩活动禁用的生命周期挂钩ID列表
fields.name: ignored_lifecycle_hook_ids

parameters.help_en: The context information of the lifecycle hook
parameters.help_zh: 生命周期挂钩的上下文信息
parameters.name: lifecycle_hook_context

parameters.help_en: The metadata of the scaling activity
parameters.name: activity_metadata

parameters.help_en:
The execution mode. Valid values:

None: not specified. Normal scaling is performed.
PlanOnly: scaling is not triggered. Only elastic planning is performed, and the planning results are returned in PlanResult, including instance type, zone ID, billing method, and the number of instances to be created.

Default value: None
parameters.help_zh:
执行模式。取值范围：

None：未指定，正常扩缩容。
PlanOnly：不触发扩缩容，仅执行弹性规划，在PlanResult中返回规划的结果，包括实例规格、可用区ID、付费类型和创建的实例数量等信息。

默认为None
parameters.name: execution_mode

schema.description_en: The response parameters for triggering elastic scaling based on a specified adjustment rule
schema.description_zh: 基于指定调整规则触发弹性扩缩容返回参数

ActivityType.description_en:
The type of the scaling activity.

If `ActivityType` is set to `CapacityChange`, the scaling activity corresponding to the returned `ScalingActivityId` only modifies the expected number of instances in the scaling group without immediately performing scaling.

Applicable scope: scaling groups with the expected number of instances configured
ActivityType.description_zh:
伸缩活动的类型。

当`ActivityType`为`CapacityChange`时，表示返回值`ScalingActivityId`对应伸缩活动仅修改伸缩组期望实例数，没有立刻执行扩缩。

适用范围：期望实例数类型的伸缩组

PlanResult.description_en: The elastic planning results returned when ExecutionMode is set to PlanOnly
PlanResult.description_zh: 当ExecutionMode为PlanOnly时，返回的弹性规划的结果

ResourceAllocations.description_en: The resource allocation information in the elastic planning results
ResourceAllocations.description_zh: 弹性规划结果中的资源分配信息

InstanceChargeType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

Prepaid: subscription.
Postpaid: pay-as-you-go
InstanceChargeType.description_zh:
付费类型，返回值如下：

Prepaid：包年包月。
Postpaid：按量付费

SpotStrategy.description_en:
The preemption policy of the instance. Valid values:

NoSpot: a pay-as-you-go instance.
SpotWithPriceLimit: a spot instance with a maximum price limit.
SpotAsPriceGo: a spot instance priced at the market price at the time of purchase
SpotStrategy.description_zh:
实例的抢占策略。取值范围：

NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式实例

ScalingActivityId.description_en: The ID of the scaling activity
